detail.longDescription: Bloomberg: AI’s environmental impact per task balloons with more complexity. “As artificial intelligence (AI) use shifts from simple, one-off queries to longer and more complex tasks, the added computing required results in a dramatically larger environmental footprint. The energy needed to build a web app using some models is equivalent to powering a home for 2 1/2 hours.
